params.body:
`hand.mjs workingset` printed one summary line and then asked for the YubiKey PIN at once. It now explains first:

```
Signing a working set: glk-transferor, hoet, portal, up to B2, until di 27/10 08:30.
It replaces the working set Portal holds now. Inside it, one passkey touch in Portal admits a project; outside it, the passkey admits nothing.

  1. Type the PIN of your YubiKey.
  2. Touch the YubiKey when it blinks.
  3. Portal keeps the set. Then admit each project with the passkey on the workbench page.
```

Output only; what is signed is unchanged. `node --test lib/*.test.mjs`: 38 pass, 1 fails, and it is unrelated (stocklist-read.test.mjs expects the bundled tool snapshot without `photos_sample`; this PR touches only the output in lib/hand.mjs).
